name: YouTube / Web 1080p
description: H.264, high quality, plays on every browser, phone and player. The safe default.

name: YouTube 4K (2× size)
description: Doubles the composition size (1080p becomes 4K). Heavy: expect long renders and big files.

name: Social media (fast)
description: H.264 tuned for speed. Good for drafts and client previews.

name: Small file (chat, email)
description: Half resolution and strong compression, usually a few MB.

name: Apple devices (HEVC)
description: H.265: smaller files than H.264 at the same quality. Plays natively on macOS, iOS and recent Windows/Android.

name: Edit master: ProRes 422 HQ
description: Near-lossless intermediate for Premiere, DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut. Very large files.

name: ProRes 4444 with transparency
description: Keeps the alpha channel for compositing in editors and VFX tools.

name: WebM with transparency
description: VP9 with alpha for web overlays and browser-based players (Chrome, Firefox, Edge).

name: Animated GIF
description: Half size, every other frame, loops forever. GIFs get big quickly: keep them short.

name: PNG image sequence
description: One numbered PNG per frame in a folder, for VFX, texture work or your own encoder.

name: Audio only: WAV
description: Uncompressed audio track of the composition.
